（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
Shanghai Municipal Council.
C. I. D.
I. O. RED
No. 566
Date 13.9.16
September 12th 1916

Sir,
An office for the repatriation of the rebels has been established on Zau Tsen Road 肇周路 near the West Gate. It is reported that on the 11th instant Han Hwe 韩恢 received $3,000 from the Nanking Provincial Government to relieve the more pressing needs of the rebels.
General Yang has received a report from one of his detectives that there is an office of the Manchu Restoration Party situated in the Tien Pao Li 天保里 North Chekiang Road. He has given instructions to the Chapel Police to investigate the matter.
The troops have been allowed a holiday to-day being the Autumn festival but no leave has been granted.
The workmen at the Arsenal have been granted three days holiday but they have not received their pay on account of the financial stringency of the Government.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.

（签名）
12a
Captain Superintendent of Police.

pages.zh:
编号
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处（侦探股））
上海公共租界工部局。
刑事侦缉处。
I. O. RED
第 566 号
日期 1916年9月13日
1916年9月12日

先生：
在西门附近的肇周路已设立一处叛军遣返办公室。据报，韩恢于本月11日从江苏省政府领取了3,000美元，以缓解叛军更为紧迫的需求。
杨将军从其一名侦探处收到报告，称在北浙江路天保里设有一处满清复辟党办公室。他已指示巡捕房对此事进行调查。
今日正值中秋节，部队已获准休假，但未批准离营假。
兵工厂的工人已获准三天假期，但由于政府财政紧张，他们尚未领到薪水。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
首席探长。

（签名）
12a
警务处总监。

（手写批注：... 12.）
